title: RoadRestriction
description: One road restriction, including closures: road name, regulated section as a point, line or area, status and category.

address.description: Address of the location, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject)

location.description: The regulated section, as a GeoJSON geometry. A point for a single-spot restriction, a LineString for a section, a polygon for an area, matching the point/line/area regulation forms (点規制・線規制・面規制) of the NPA's traffic regulation data format (交通規制情報（拡張版標準フォーマット）説明書 Ver: k_2.1, JARTIC, 2025-01-20)

restrictionStatus.description: Normalised restriction state, the value space of Smart Data Models RoadSegment.status: closed (no traffic), limited (traffic possible but not in full capacity), open (restriction lifted or not yet in place). The local wording goes in statusLabel; regulationCategory gives the finer public-sector category. When no value fits, leave it out and give the local wording in statusLabel

regulationCategory.description: Regulation category, from the legend of MLIT's Road Information Provision System (道路情報提供システム 通行規制情報, road-info-prvs.mlit.go.jp, accessed 2026-09-24): the categories a road administrator uses for a driver-facing closure or restriction. Optional and independent of restrictionStatus

statusLabel.description: The restriction status in the local or source system's wording (依頼中, 通行止め中, 解除済み). Required when restrictionStatus is left out
